The Polydrain MB450 chamber base is a versatile and durable foundation for 450mm inspection chambers, designed specifically for use with 110mm underground drainage systems. Trusted by contractors and merchants alike, the Polydrain MB450 chamber base delivers a reliable, regulation-compliant solution for modern drainage systems, balancing ease of installation with long-term performance.

product.description:
Bondloc B572 White Pipe Seal is designed for the locking and sealing of metal pipes and fittings. The product cures when confined in the absence of air between close fitting metal surfaces and prevents loosening and leakage from shock and vibration. The thixotropic nature reduces the migration of liquid product after application to the substrate. 

Has a good chemical/solvent resistance to Ethanol, Motor Oil, Unleaded Petrol and Brake Fluid. B572 is unusual in that it does not fully cure until some 60 hours after application, allowing for re-alignment of elbows and joints. 

Replaces tapes and dopes, stops gas and fluid leaks on most metals and assists in lubricating during assembly. Will not shred or tear which would contaminate your system. Use it to seal against oils, gases, chemicals, water and steam etc.

Resin: Dimethacrylate.
Colour: White paste.
Cure speed with activator: Not recommended.

product.name: Pressure Reducing Valve, Pepte 22mm Compression Fit, 15mm Inserts and Gauge, Adjustable 0 to 6 Bar Outlet
product.description:
This pressure reducing valve (PRV) is designed to stabilise and lower inlet pressure from mains or boosted water systems, helping to reduce noise and protect plumbing equipment for longer service life. Supplied as 22mm with 15mm reducing inserts, it is suitable for static and dynamic water pressures. A reliable, easy-to-install pressure reducing valve designed for stable water control and long-term protection of plumbing systems.

- Pre-set to 3 bar during manufacture
- Compatible with 22mm or 15mm pipework (with inserts)
- Helps prevent system damage and reduces noise
- Built-in pressure gauge for accurate readings
- Ideal for domestic and commercial plumbing systems

Adjusting the outlet pressure:
1. Turn off the mains stopcock
2. Leave a tap in the property open (e.g. a bath tap)
3. Adjust the PRV (using the screw on the plastic head)
4. Turn on the mains stopcock
5. Read the pressure on the gauge (with the tap still open)
6. If the outlet pressure is too low/high, repeat steps 1-5 (this may take a few times to get right)

A tap should always be left open while adjusting the PRV (the gauge indicates the correct pressure with water flowing through the valve). Do not adjust the PRV with water running through the valve. The pressure gauge may show an increased reading with the stopcock open and all taps/outlets closed; simply open a tap to view the correct pressure.

Maintenance: 
Clean the stainless steel filter periodically - Isolate the valve, remove the plastic head, take out the filter, rinse with warm water, and reinstall.

Using the 15mm Reducing Inserts:
Remove the 22mm olive and fit the one-piece insert. Tighten the compression nut until the insert partially detaches to create an olive, then tighten normally for a secure seal.

product.name: 3 x Lowflow Shallow Drainage Channel Black Plastic Grating 50mm Deep x 1m Length x 125mm Width  Suitable for Driveways 3T Limit
product.description: The NovaDrain Shallow Domestic Drainage Channel is a lightweight, high-capacity surface water drainage system designed for quick and straightforward installation. It is CE classified A15 (15kN/1.5 tonne) in accordance with EN 1433 standards and has been independently load tested to 3 tonne GVW for added confidence, meeting the demands of modern domestic vehicles. This makes it ideal for pedestrian areas and light domestic vehicular traffic, including driveways, patios, garden paths, and garage thresholds. Each channel length incorporates built-in corner and T-junction connections, removing the need for separate junction boxes to reduce both installation time and overall cost. Preformed cutting edges at regular intervals along the channel body allowing for easy end capping or directional changes as required. Installation is further simplified with quick push-and-twist soil pipe adaptors and convenient push-fit end caps. With a channel body depth of 50mm, the system provides easy shallow dig applications and maintains great flow rate performance. Available with a durable twin-slotted, textured anti-slip plastic grate that is easily removable for cleaning and maintenance, both of which are designed for efficient surface water drainage

product.name: ENGO E25 Smart Thermostat Kit Zigbee Radiator Control White
product.description: The ENGO E25 Kit is a smart radiator heating solution designed for customers who want room by room radiator control using ENGO smart heating technology. This kit includes the ENGO E25 battery powered smart thermostat and the ENGO smart radiator valve ETRV-M30. The thermostat measures room temperature and sends heating setpoints wirelessly using Zigbee RF 868 communication. The smart radiator valve physically opens and closes the radiator valve to regulate heat output, providing accurate and efficient radiator heating control. One E25 thermostat can control multiple smart radiator valves within the same room, making this kit suitable for rooms with more than one radiator. Important smart functionality notice:This kit does not include an ENGO gateway. The thermostat and smart radiator valve can be paired locally for basic heating control. However, smart features such as app control, heating schedules, timers, and remote access require an ENGO gateway, which must be purchased separately. The thermostat itself is not programmable. It allows manual temperature adjustment only. All scheduling and automation are handled through the ENGO app when a gateway is added. This kit is designed specifically for ENGO smart heating systems and is not compatible with other brands or generic Zigbee hubs. It is ideal for customers who already own an ENGO gateway or who want to add app control later.

product.name: 10 Meters Corrugated Pipe 1.25" (32mm) with 2 x Double Wire Clips Set
15mm x 1/2 Inch Angle Service Valve Chrome - Isolate Taps, Toilets and Appliances, Easy Fit No Soldering
product.description:
Need to change a tap or fix a leaky toilet without turning the water off to the whole house? This chrome angle service valve lets you shut off a single tap, toilet cistern or appliance in seconds, so the rest of your home keeps running while you work. It is a simple, tidy fix that makes every future repair quicker and less stressful.

The valve has a 15mm compression inlet that fits standard copper pipe, so there is no soldering and no blowtorch - just slide it on and tighten the nut with a spanner. The 1/2 inch BSP outlet connects straight to tap tails, flexible tap connectors and appliance supply hoses. The angled body turns the connection through 90 degrees, which makes it ideal for tight spaces under a sink or behind a toilet, and keeps pipe runs neat and tidy.

A quarter-turn lever gives instant, positive isolation: turn it across the pipe to stop the water, turn it back in line to restore the flow. The body is chrome-plated brass for durability and a smart, corrosion-resistant finish that looks good on exposed pipework in a kitchen, bathroom or utility room.

A sensible choice for homeowners, landlords and anyone fitting a new tap, a washing machine or a dishwasher. Used in UK domestic plumbing on tap tails, toilet cistern connections and appliance supply lines. Fitting one on every supply point is the easy way to be ready for the next job.

product.name: Hoses UK 25mm Clear PVC Corrugated Flexible Water Butt Hose 1m Reinforced Downpipe Connector Rainwater Harvesting Pump Pond
product.description: The Hoses UK Clear PVC Corrugated Water Butt & Pond Hose is a lightweight, UV-resistant and flexible hose designed for water transfer, pond circulation, and general fluid handling. Its transparent design allows easy monitoring of water or fluid movement, making it ideal for applications that benefit from visual inspection. Manufactured with a smooth PVC inner wall and a corrugated PVC outer layer, the hose incorporates a high-tensile plastic rib reinforcement to provide durability and crush resistance while maintaining flexibility. The clear corrugated PVC hose is designed for medium-duty environments requiring a crush-resistant, UV-stable, and easy-to-handle flexible hose. Operating from -10 degrees C to +65 degrees C (peak +70 degrees C) and compliant with BS EN ISO 3994-2001, this corrugated PVC hose provides reliability, resilience, and ease of use in a variety of light to medium-duty environments. Key features include a smooth bore for consistent water or fluid flow, a flexible corrugated exterior for efficient fluid transfer, and a tough plastic rib reinforcement that resists crushing and maintains flow integrity under mechanical stress. The transparent construction allows operators to monitor flow and detect blockages or contamination quickly, which is particularly useful in pond systems, aquatics, and industrial water circulation. This hose is also widely used for workshop water transfer and light chemical solutions where visibility and flexible installation are essential. Available in a range of sizes with internal diameters from 19 mm to 50 mm and wall thicknesses from 2 mm to 4 mm, the Hoses UK Clear PVC Corrugated Water Butt & Pond Hose is suitable for a variety of applications including pond and aquarium circulation, garden water features, drainage systems, irrigation setups, and light industrial fluid handling tasks.

product.description: Thermopanel Centre Square Drain Wet Room Shower Tray Former (20/25mm)  The Thermopanel Square Centre Drain Shower Tray Former is the perfect solution for creating a stylish, flush walk-in shower or wet room. Unlike bulky acrylic trays, it provides a seamless, tile-ready base that integrates beautifully with your bathroom floor. Lightweight but exceptionally strong, the tray includes a pre-formed 2% gradient for efficient drainage and is coated with a cementitious layer, ready for tiling with ceramic, porcelain, stone, or mosaics. It comes with a centre-positioned square drain, with a choice of six grate designs – Leaf, Tile, Square, Sunburst, Spiral or Radial – and three finishes: Black, Gold, or Stainless Steel. The Thermopanel system is suitable for timber or concrete floors, works seamlessly with electric underfloor heating, and is supported by a lifetime warranty when fitted according to the manufacturer’s instructions.  Key Features:  20mm or 25mm depth options. Square centre drain with 6 grate designs (Leaf, Tile, Square, Sunburst, Spiral or Radial). Choice of finishes: Black, Gold, Stainless Steel. Waste included. Pre-made 2% fall ensures fast water flow. Tile-ready surface, suitable for ceramic, porcelain, mosaics & natural stone. Lightweight, strong, and easy to install. Trim up to 50mm from each edge for flexibility. Compatible with electric underfloor heating. Suitable for timber and concrete floors. Backed by a 25 year warranty.

product.name: 32mm to 45mm (1 1/4" To 1 3/4") Plastic Hose Connector Red Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes
product.description:
This Plastic 45 Degree Reducer Barbed Joiner is designed to connect two hoses of different internal diameters while providing a smooth 45° directional change. Ideal for garden irrigation, pond systems, water transfer lines, and general fluid applications, it allows flexible routing where space is limited or where a gentle angle is required to reduce hose strain.

Manufactured from durable ABS plastic, this fitting offers reliable strength while remaining lightweight and easy to install. This component is a precision 3D printed ABS part, produced for accurate sizing and dependable performance. The barbed ends provide a secure push-fit connection inside flexible hose, helping to minimise leaks and maintain consistent flow. The reducer design enables connection between two different hose sizes without the need for additional adapters.

The 45-degree angle supports improved hose routing compared to straight connectors, helping reduce kinking and stress on pipework. Suitable for use with PVC hose, rubber hose, and other flexible pipe systems, this joiner performs reliably in outdoor and wet environments. Resistant to water and general wear, it provides dependable performance for both DIY users and professional installers. Whether adapting hose sizes or changing direction within a system, this reducer barbed joiner offers a practical and efficient solution.

product.name: Westco 22mm x 3/4" Brass Press Coupling - No Soldering, Press to Female Thread Water Fitting
product.description:
Need to connect 22mm press-fit pipe to a 3/4 inch female threaded fitting without getting the blowtorch out? This Westco brass press coupling does exactly that. One end is a 22mm press-fit connection for your pipework, the other is a 3/4" female iron thread (shown as C x FI), so it joins your pipe run straight onto a threaded valve, tap, cylinder connection or other male-threaded part. It is a simple, quick way to make a strong, leak-free join in domestic plumbing, with no solder, no flux and no compression fittings to wrestle with.

Built from solid brass, it is designed for long-term strength and a secure, permanent joint once pressed. It is suitable for both hot and cold water systems, so it works equally well on a cold feed as on a hot water run. The press-fit design means a single crimp with a suitable press tool makes the connection, which makes the job faster and tidier than traditional methods, and a good choice if you are a weekend DIYer who would rather not solder, or a landlord looking for a straightforward, dependable replacement part.

Check the sizes before you buy: 22mm press end and 3/4 inch female thread. If those match the pipe and fitting you are connecting, this coupling is a neat, no-fuss solution for repairs, upgrades and new pipework alike. Supplied as a single fitting.

product.name: Westco 22mm x 1" Brass Press Coupling - No Soldering Needed, Joins Copper Pipe to 1" Male Thread Water Fitting
product.description:
Need to connect 22mm copper pipe to a 1" male threaded fitting without getting the blowtorch out? This Westco 22mm x 1" brass press coupling does it with a single press. One end is a 22mm press-fit (C) connection for copper water pipe, and the other end is a 1" male iron (MI) thread, so it is a simple way to join pipework to a threaded valve, cylinder connection or other female-threaded fitting. There is no solder, no flux and no compression nut to tighten, which makes it a sensible choice for a confident DIYer or anyone who wants to avoid hiring a plumber for a straightforward pipe connection. Just cut the pipe square, deburr it, push it into the press end and make the join with a suitable press tool for a quick, clean and permanent joint.

Made from durable brass, it is suitable for hot and cold water systems and is a handy fitting for domestic plumbing in kitchens, bathrooms, utility rooms and airing cupboards. It is a single fitting, so you only buy what you need for the job. Key details at a glance: size 22mm x 1" (C x MI), brass body, press-fit connection, for use with 22mm copper press-fit pipe systems.

product.name: Westco 22mm x 3/4" Brass Press Coupling - C x FI Female Thread Fitting for Hot and Cold Water Plumbing
product.description: The Westco 22mm x 3/4" brass press coupling joins 22mm press-fit pipe to a 3/4" female iron (FI) thread, making it a straightforward way to move from a pressed pipe run onto a threaded connection. The size is 22mm x 3/4" and the ends are C x FI: a 22mm press end (C) on one side and a 3/4" female thread on the other. It is a water fitting suitable for hot and cold water systems, so it suits central heating and domestic plumbing alike, whether you are extending a run, adding a threaded connection point or replacing an existing coupling during a renovation or landlord repair. Made from strong brass, it gives a durable, secure joint that is built to last behind walls, under floors and in airing cupboards. The press-fit design means quick installation with a suitable press tool, with no soldering and no naked flame needed on site. Check the pipe size (22mm) and the mating male thread (3/4") before you order, and you have a clean, trade-standard connection that tradespeople and confident DIYers can rely on.

product.name: Aluminium Beaded Hose Connector for Silicone Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes (102mm OD, 600mm Long)
product.description: Our Beaded Aluminium Hose Joiners (Swaged Connectors) provide a robust and professional solution for joining hoses in high-pressure or high-temperature applications. Manufactured from high-grade 6063 aluminium, these joiners feature swaged ends with precision-formed beads to prevent hose blow-off and ensure a secure fit under boost or vacuum conditions. The lightweight yet strong aluminium construction resists corrosion and performs reliably in both automotive and industrial environments. These joiners are ideal for use in turbocharger systems, intercoolers, radiators, and custom intake/exhaust setups. Compatible with silicone, rubber, and other flexible hoses, they maintain a strong grip when used with standard hose clamps. The smooth internal bore promotes optimal airflow or fluid transfer without turbulence or restriction. Available in a wide range of diameters from 13mm to 102mm, offering easy integration into custom pipework setups. Whether you're repairing, upgrading, or building a new system, these connectors deliver strength, reliability, and clean aesthetics for a polished result

product.name: Aluminium Beaded Hose Connector for Silicone Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes (40mm OD, 450mm Long)
product.description: Our Beaded Aluminium Hose Joiners (Swaged Connectors) provide a robust and professional solution for joining hoses in high-pressure or high-temperature applications. The lightweight yet strong aluminium construction resists corrosion and performs reliably in both automotive and industrial environments. These joiners are ideal for use in turbocharger systems, intercoolers, radiators, and custom intake/exhaust setups. Available in a wide range of diameters from 13mm to 102mm, offering easy integration into custom pipework setups. Whether you're repairing, upgrading, or building a new system, these connectors deliver strength, reliability, and clean aesthetics for a polished result

product.name: Hoses UK 25mm Rubber Heater Hose Black - 9m EPDM High-Temp High-Pressure SAE J20R3 Automotive Coolant Heating Radiator Pipe
product.description:
The Hoses UK Rubber Heater Hose is built for reliable performance in automotive, industrial, and agricultural heating and cooling systems. Manufactured from heat-resistant EPDM rubber with a smooth bore inner layer and weather-resistant synthetic rubber outer, it delivers efficient fluid transfer while standing up to heat, ozone, and environmental exposure. High tensile fibre yarn reinforcement prevents collapse under pressure and maintains flexibility for routing in confined or complex spaces.

The hose operates safely across a temperature range of -20°C to +100°C, with a peak tolerance of +120°C, and sustains a working pressure of 10 Bar (burst pressure 30 Bar). It is manufactured to SAE J20R3 standards, making it a trusted choice for both professional and maintenance applications. Available in four internal diameters — 16 mm, 19 mm, 22 mm, and 25 mm — and cut lengths from 1 to 20 metres, so you receive exactly what you need without unnecessary waste.

product.name: Flexible Rubber Car Heater Radiator Coolant Hose 13mm Bore 9m SAE J20R3 Steel Wire Reinforced Anti Kink High Temperature
product.description:
This Rubber Wire Reinforced Hose is a heavy-duty industrial hose designed for demanding fluid transfer applications where strength, pressure resistance, and durability are essential. Manufactured with a smooth black synthetic SBR rubber inner layer, it provides reliable flow characteristics and resistance to wear during continuous use. Reinforced with two-ply fabric cords and a steel wire spiral, the hose maintains its shape under suction and pressure, preventing collapse and improving safety during operation.

The outer layer is constructed from smooth black synthetic SBR rubber, offering excellent resistance to abrasion, weathering, and general site conditions. Designed to operate within a temperature range of -20°C to +80°C, with peak resistance up to +85°C, this hose is suitable for industrial, agricultural, and engineering applications where dependable performance is required.

With a working pressure rating of 10 bar and a bursting pressure of 30 bar, the hose delivers consistent performance in both pressure and vacuum systems. Manufactured to SAE J20R3 standard, it is ideal for suction, discharge, fluid transfer, and general-purpose industrial use. Supplied in 20 metre coils, this wire reinforced rubber hose provides a reliable solution for professional users requiring flexibility, strength, and long service life.

product.name: Auto Silicone Hoses 8mm ID Black 2 Ply Silicone Radiator Coolant Heater Hose 9 Metres Flexible Water Coolant Pipe
product.description: High-performance black 2-ply silicone radiator, coolant and heater hose with a 8mm internal diameter, supplied as a continuous 9 metres cut length. Constructed from premium smooth-bore silicone rubber reinforced with two plies of woven polyester, this hose delivers outstanding heat resistance, flexibility and service life compared with conventional EPDM rubber coolant hose. It resists ozone, UV, ageing, water, antifreeze and coolant chemicals, remaining flexible and reliable in demanding under-bonnet conditions. Suited to radiator, heater, coolant, header-tank, breather, induction and turbo boost applications across automotive, motorsport, marine, agricultural and industrial builds. Operating range approximately -50C to +180C with short peaks to +200C. IMPORTANT: silicone is intended for water and coolant systems only and must NOT be used for fuel, oil or petroleum products; select a fluorosilicone-lined hose for those duties. Match the bore to your pipe outside diameter and secure with suitable hose clamps.
